title: Count Vowels
problem: Given a single line of lowercase text, print how many of its characters are vowels (a, e, i, o, u).
starter_code:
# Read a line of lowercase text.
# Print how many of its characters are vowels (a, e, i, o, u).

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about checking each character of the line one at a time and keeping a running count.
hints.2: Loop over the string directly (for ch in line), and check whether each character is a, e, i, o, or u.
hints.3: line = input(); print(sum(1 for ch in line if ch in 'aeiou'))

failure_explanation: Spaces and consonants should not be counted, only a/e/i/o/u - and remember the count includes every vowel occurrence in the whole line, not just the number of distinct vowel letters that appear.
